summary: SK Telecom's subsidiary SK Broadband resolved on August 27, 2026 to approve a horizontal spin-off of its data center/CDN and subsea cable international leased-line businesses into a new unlisted company, SK Horizon Co., Ltd. (tentative). The spin-off, effective February 1, 2027, follows Korea Commercial Code Articles 530-2 to 530-13 and requires a special shareholder resolution at an extraordinary general meeting. Both surviving and spun-off entities remain unlisted. Joint liability for pre-spin-off debts applies, with rights of recovery between entities. Key watch: shareholder approval, asset allocation details, and regulatory timing.
